paragraphs: Nutrislice sells digital menus, signage, food labels, and ordering on one platform for foodservice. Nutrislice Spotlight covers wireless digital food labels that go everywhere and update from anywhere. Nutrislice Showcase puts menus on the big screen, with a look-and-feel that can be customized for a brand. Nutrislice Pro offers a contactless ordering experience meant to speed up lines and increase ticket sizes.

Guests and staff use the Nutrislice Menus app to browse daily menu items, view nutrition information, and plan for dietary and allergy restrictions. Operators can update menus from the dining floor with the Nutrislice Sidekick app, which is available on iOS and Android.

Schools are offered online menus, digital signage, mobile ordering, and digital labels for students, parents, and staff. Nutrislice integrates with K12 systems and turns data into ADA compliant menus. On campus the offer is integrated mobile menus, contactless ordering options, dynamic onsite display marketing, and easy-to-update digital food labels. Corporate cafeterias are a stated market, with the same ordering, menus, and signage aimed at cafeteria guests.
